firmographics.narrative_md: First United Bank is a regional bank headquartered in Phoenix, AZ. It reports $16.3 billion in total assets and has operated since 1951. It is regulated by NCUA and employs approximately 1,001 people across 25 branches. Its overall digital maturity is assessed at 2.7 out of 5 across the DMA capability framework.
